## Pregnancy evidence brief: daridorexant

**Identity:** Daridorexant was exactly matched as the ingredient daridorexant. The selected product record is **QUVIVIQ (daridorexant) tablet, film coated**, from Idorsia Pharmaceuticals Ltd. [S15](https://rxnav.nlm.nih.gov/REST/rxcui/2591497/properties.json) [S7](https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/lookup.cfm?setid=3a2d1503-b816-40c9-9fac-7e03c5a3bcef)

### Evidence axes

| Requested axis | Retrieved evidence |
|---|---|
| **Effects on the pregnant person** | **Empty clinical-findings row:** No pregnancy-specific maternal-effect findings were retrieved. The evidence brief includes a label coverage statement that there are no available data in pregnant women to evaluate drug-associated risks of major birth defects, miscarriage, or other adverse maternal or fetal outcomes. This is not evidence of safety. [S7](https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/lookup.cfm?setid=3a2d1503-b816-40c9-9fac-7e03c5a3bcef) |
| **Measured fetal or infant exposure** | **Empty row:** No measured human fetal or infant exposure data were retrieved. No human fetal-transfer measurement or infant specimen concentration was reported in the retrieved brief. |
| **Observed fetal or infant outcomes** | **Empty observed-outcomes row:** No human pregnancy-outcome study findings were retrieved. Separate animal label context was returned, but it is not human fetal or infant outcome evidence. [S7](https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/lookup.cfm?setid=3a2d1503-b816-40c9-9fac-7e03c5a3bcef) |

### Animal context

The label’s retrieved animal context describes reproductive studies in pregnant rats and rabbits and reports no fetal toxicity or malformation under the study conditions. These findings are from animals and do not establish human pregnancy outcomes. [S7](https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/lookup.cfm?setid=3a2d1503-b816-40c9-9fac-7e03c5a3bcef)

### Maternal pharmacokinetic data

**No maternal pharmacokinetic data were found in the retrieved label clinical-considerations material or retrieved PubMed abstracts.** This is not evidence of safety.

### FAERS report-only context

The queried FAERS subset returned the following report terms:

- Fetal exposure during pregnancy: **11**
- Premature baby: **10**
- Neonatal hypotonia: **9**
- Moaning: **9**
- Neonatal behavioural syndrome: **9**
- Neonatal respiratory distress: **9**
- Cardiac disorder: **7**
- Cardiomegaly: **7**

These are reporting volumes from reports matching the stated query, not confirmed clinical outcomes, rates, or evidence of causation. An exposure denominator was unavailable, and the source population was not confirmed. The results cannot be generalized to all infants or all people exposed to daridorexant. [S1](https://api.fda.gov/drug/event.json?search=patient.drug.openfda.generic_name%3A%22daridorexant%22+AND+patient.reaction.reactionmeddrapt%3A%22foetal+exposure+during+pregnancy%22&count=patient.reaction.reactionmeddrapt.exact&limit=8) [S11](https://open.fda.gov/apis/drug/event/)

### Literature retrieval limitation

The bounded PubMed pregnancy search returned three records, but abstract text was retrieved for **0 of 3**:

- PMID 36630579 [S13](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36630579/)
- PMID 35802843 [S12](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/35802843/)
- PMID 36630580 [S14](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36630580/)

No records were unreturned or associated with failed abstract lookups. Titles alone were not used to summarize study outcomes. The search was not exhaustive. [S8](https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi?db=pubmed&term=%28%28%22daridorexant%22%5BMeSH+Terms%5D+OR+%22daridorexant%22%5BSubstance+Name%5D+OR+%22daridorexant%22%5BTitle%2FAbstract%5D%29%29+AND+%28%22Pregnancy%22%5BMeSH+Terms%5D+OR+pregnan%2A%5BTitle%2FAbstract%5D+OR+gestation%2A%5BTitle%2FAbstract%5D%29&retmax=5&sort=relevance&retmode=json)

## FDA pregnancy registry contact

- **Registry:** QUVIVIQ Pregnancy Registry  
- **Status as listed:** Ongoing  
- **Website:** [www.QuviviqPregnancyStudy.com](https://www.QuviviqPregnancyStudy.com)  
- **Phone:** 1-833-400-9611  
- **FDA directory:** [S16](https://www.fda.gov/consumers/pregnancy-exposure-registries/list-pregnancy-exposure-registries)  
- **Registry website:** [S22](https://www.QuviviqPregnancyStudy.com)

This is directory information only; it is not a recommendation or an eligibility determination. The retrieved listing states that current enrollment and eligibility should be verified directly with the registry. The FDA directory is not comprehensive. [S16](https://www.fda.gov/consumers/pregnancy-exposure-registries/list-pregnancy-exposure-registries)

A filtered ClinicalTrials.gov search returned **no recruiting records** for daridorexant and pregnancy in that query; this does not establish that no other study exists elsewhere. [S2](https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies?query.term=daridorexant+AND+%28pregnancy%29&filter.overallStatus=RECRUITING&pageSize=20&format=json)
